name: Short-Stay Entry (Visa-Free / Visa C)

qualifying_event.description: Serbia grants visa-free entry, for up to 90 days within a 180-day period, on two separate bases: (1) nationality -- citizens of the US, UK, EU member states, and many other countries do not need a visa at all; and (2) a specific rule for holders of a valid Schengen, UK, or US visa, or a residence permit in the Schengen area, EU, or US, regardless of their own nationality. Nationals not covered by either basis need a short-stay Visa C (tourism/business, up to 90 days) or, for stays of 90-180 days, a long-stay Visa D.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Valid passport (90+ days beyond departure); for visa applicants: proof of purpose of stay, invitation letter (where applicable), travel medical insurance, proof of sufficient funds and return travel.

requirements.blocker_text: Citizens of the US, UK, EU member states, and many other countries can enter Serbia without a visa for up to 90 days in a 180-day period. The full nationality-by-nationality list is published by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs per-country and was not fully reproduced here.

requirement_groups.name: Holder of a Schengen/UK/US visa or residence permit

requirements.blocker_text: A foreign national holding a valid Schengen, UK, or US visa, or a residence permit in the Schengen area, EU, or US, may enter, transit, and stay in Serbia for up to 90 days in a 6-month period, regardless of their own nationality's visa regime.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain a valid Schengen, UK, or US visa or residence permit.

evidence_required.document: Valid passport (valid 90+ days beyond intended departure)
Proof of sufficient funds and return travel (for visa applicants)

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days in a 180-day period

sources.title: Serbian Ministry of Foreign Affairs -- visa requirements: exemption for holders of a valid Schengen/UK/US visa or Schengen/EU/US residence permit, 90 days in 6 months; Visa C (up to 90 days) and Visa D (90-180 days) for others; general document/funds/insurance requirements
Global Citizen Solutions -- confirms Serbia's inbound visa-free regime covers US/UK/EU and many other nationalities for up to 90 days, separate from the Schengen/UK/US-visa-holder exemption

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Serbia). STATUS: DRAFT -- the MFA's own visa-requirements page (tier-1) confirms the visa-holder/residence-permit exemption in detail, but its full nationality-by-nationality visa-free list is published per-country on a separate portal (mfa.gov.rs/en/citizens/travel-serbia/visa-regime) as an A-Z index of individual country pages rather than a single reproducible list, so the general nationality-based exemption here is corroborated only by a tier-3 secondary source. Two genuinely distinct legal bases for visa-free entry are modeled as separate requirement groups (OR logic) rather than conflated into one, since a traveler can qualify via either nationality alone or via holding a third-country visa/permit regardless of their own nationality.
